node.statement: Applying lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation with D=D_*, t=t_1, epsilon_R=epsilon, B_R=C^{m+1}, A_R=A, and u_R=u_1 gives an error-improved map v_1:C^{m+1}->A with the same target and amplification form, carrying the inclusion tag and a recorded extended-inclusion defect d_1<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, and satisfying ||v_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon.
